verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's docs describe an MCP Gateway in the proxy that registers MCP servers behind one fixed endpoint, with per-key and per-team access control. Servers are added through the admin UI's "Add New MCP Server" flow. Their tools can be listed and called through /mcp-rest endpoints, either directly or via LLM calls. Missing for 10: documented transport options (stdio/SSE/HTTP), detail on how models invoke the MCP tools during completions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
